nodeData.topic: Quick-Revision: High-Yield Chronic & Traumatic Pancreas Map

children.topic: Defining Mechanism / Diagnostic Marker: Progressive fibroinflammatory destruction; Low Fecal Elastase
Classic Imaging Sign: "Chain of Lakes" (alternating strictures and dilations) on MRCP/ERCP
Standard Treatment of Choice: Puestow Procedure (lateral pancreaticojejunostomy) for diffuse pain
Defining Mechanism / Diagnostic Marker: Superficial contusion or peripheral parenchymal laceration; Intact Main Duct
Classic Imaging Sign: Normal or minimal parenchymal stranding on CT
Standard Treatment of Choice: Conservative Management (NPO, IV fluids)
Defining Mechanism / Diagnostic Marker: Deep laceration or transection of neck, body, or tail; Duct Disruption
Classic Imaging Sign: Laceration extending through the duct on contrast CT / ERCP
Standard Treatment of Choice: Exploratory Laparotomy & Distal Pancreatectomy
Defining Mechanism / Diagnostic Marker: Severe crush of pancreatic head or combined pancreaticoduodenal injury
Classic Imaging Sign: Complex duodenal/head hematoma or contrast extravasation
Standard Treatment of Choice: Wide Surgical Drainage or Whipple's Procedure (high-risk)
